title: Add Request ID Middleware for Traceable Logging
description: Introduce a lightweight middleware that generates a unique request ID for every incoming HTTP request and attaches it to the response headers and the request context. This enables correlation of logs across services, improves debugging, and satisfies compliance requirements for traceability.
testCases: Should add a unique X-Request-Id header to every response
Should expose the same request ID on req.id for downstream middleware
Should preserve an incoming X-Request-Id header if client provides one
Should generate a new ID when the incoming header is missing or empty
acceptance: All test cases pass, request IDs are 36‑character UUIDv4 strings, no duplicate IDs appear in concurrent requests, and the header is correctly set on responses without affecting existing routes.
reason: Correlating logs across micro‑services is a common production pain point. Providing built‑in request IDs eliminates the need for third‑party packages, aligns with the framework's zero‑dependency goal, and enhances observability for Yantraverse users.
